prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup refinement. Edit the attached Les Saisons Home Assistant dashboard concept into a polished second iteration, preserving its recognizable Mucha-inspired four-season identity. Input image is the EDIT TARGET and aesthetic reference. Produce one full landscape dashboard screenshot at 1536x1024 or larger same proportion. This is a visual mockup, not implemented UI.
PRESERVE: four illustrated women representing Spring, Summer, Autumn, Winter; soft ivory parchment, muted rose and sage, brown lithographic contour lines, arched botanical panel frames, flowing Mucha-inspired hair and lettering, same main navigation and room categories. Keep art beautifully drawn, warm and flat like printed lithography. No photorealistic faces, shiny gold, dark fantasy or Art Deco.
REFINE COMPOSITION: substantially shrink each seasonal portrait to a compact arch vignette about 160-190 pixels tall (about half its original height). Do not let the art dominate the useful controls. Room cards should start around y=290 and reach y=950. Each lower panel has a short botanical portrait cap, an elegant decorative room heading, then a calm light untextured control area with generously spaced readable rows. Use four equal aligned columns. Keep text entirely clear of floral ornament and hair. Simplify outer decorative border and footer to reclaim space. Main page title “Home” should be elegant but smaller, not dominating. Use decorative Mucha lettering only for the title and room/section headings; clean readable humanist sans-serif for control names, statuses and numbers. Strong dark brown text contrast.
TOP AREA: small navigation tabs Home, Floor Plan, Media, Yard, Alexandria. Closed compact dropdown upper right labeled “Theme · Les Saisons ▾”, avoiding the large open overlay from the input. Under header, three equal-height sections: Scenes with 4 comfortable buttons Living room on / Good night / All lamps off / Pause music; Now Playing with modest album image, track “Morning Fields”, artist “The Maple Guild”, previous/pause/next controls and volume slider; Climate with “68°F”, small “Indoor” label, target “70°F” and minus/plus controls, “Heat” selected. Ensure rows and columns align and touch targets remain comfortably sized.
LOWER PANELS in same order:
SPRING — Living Room: Couch, Chez Lounge, Pappasan, Window lamp, Grow lamp as five separate switch rows with explicit On/Off text and toggle. Small footer media row “Billie · Paused” with a speaker icon.
SUMMER — Library: Torch front, Torch back, Fireplace as switch rows. Add a real media block “Library speaker”, “Paused”, play button and volume slider. Space not filler text.
AUTUMN — Outside: Outdoor 1 and Outdoor 2 switch rows, Sunset schedule switch, Rain delay switch, small secondary line “Next sunset · 5:24 PM”. A little botanical ornament may finish the panel without entering controls.
WINTER — Workshop: “Icarus” with small “3D printer” subtitle. DO NOT show an on/off toggle for printer status. Status badge “Printing”; small tidy printer image/thumbnail; progress bar “72%”; two aligned data rows “Time left 1 h 14 m” and “Nozzle 220°C”. Optional small “View printer” button. Calm status display.
Controls use muted terracotta for active, neutral cream/stone for inactive. Preserve visual hierarchy with subtle dividers. Footer only small text “Les Saisons · Refined concept”. All readings are illustrative. The overall result should be clearly the same chosen design, improved for actual everyday use rather than an entirely new design.
status: Concept only; illustrative states; not deployed
